title: NutFish and Nutrient Supplementation in Pregnancy Class to Improve Maternal and Birth Outcomes
brief_summary: This study evaluates the intervention of Nut Fish based food, micro nutrients supplementation and pregnancy class to improve maternal and birth outcome. This is cluster randomized trial with two arms. The intervention group will receive Nut Fish based supplementation, multiple micro nutrients, and pregnancy class. The control group will receive government food supplementation, iron folic acid supplementation, and pregnancy class.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* First trimester of pregnancy
* Anemic or Mid Upper Arm Circumference \< 23.5cm or no weight gain
* Plan to deliver at village midwives
* residence in the study area

Exclusion Criteria:

* severe anemia \< 7.0g/dl
